text: FAA guidance states to try to reestablish the control link and to discontinue flight until further inspection. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual says the drone will first attempt reconnection during automatic RTH, then, if no link is restored within 10 seconds, display a warning and execute the configured Signal Loss Action (and will follow that action if the C2 link remains lost beyond 10 seconds). Incident reports are unverified and claim loss of control with continued flight and failed RTH, and the UAS has not been located.
